title: Huntik Foundation's cargo jet
summary: Cargo jets are used by the Huntik Foundation to transport heavy material or vehicles across the world. There are no proper seats for passengers, and no armament.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Den Fears]] climbed aboard one of the Foundation's cargo jets, piloted by [[Foundation Pilot]], to travel from Europe to [[:Category:Baja California, Mexico|Baja California]] where [[Dante Vale]] was waiting for them. The cargo transported two motobikes as well as a safari jeep, and was ambushed upon arrival by some [[Suits]]. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

{{Clear}}
